title: quercus coccifera subsp. palaestina
intro: Quercus coccifera subsp. palaestina, commonly known as the Palestine oak, is a subspecies of evergreen tree that belongs to the Quercus genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Quercus coccifera subsp. palaestina include treating conditions such as fever, cough, and bronchitis, as well as providing relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
